data.name: AlHalima
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Al-Halima means 'the one who protects'. This name is derived from the Arabic root h-l-m, which translates to 'shelter' or 'protect'. In Islamic history, Al-Halima bint Al-Akhtar was a renowned companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), who showed great compassion and hospitality to the Prophet during his early years in Mecca.
data.spiritual_meaning: A protector and guardian of faith.
